# Test corpus

Synthetic fixtures used by the Vitest (`packages/pdf-client`), pytest (`services/pdfcore`) and
Playwright (`e2e`) suites. Every file is generated by `scripts/generate_corpus.py`, so no
third-party documents live here. `manifest.json` records what each file is and what tests should
expect from it.

PDFs are stored in Git LFS (see `.gitattributes`). After cloning, run `git lfs pull` if the files
are small text pointers; the test helpers fail with that hint when they find one.

| File                             | What it is                                     |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `pdf/basic/a-3p-a4.pdf`          | 3 labelled A4 pages                            |
| `pdf/basic/b-2p-letter.pdf`      | 2 labelled US Letter pages                     |
| `pdf/basic/c-1p-a5-rot90.pdf`    | 1 A5 page with `/Rotate 90`                    |
| `pdf/edge/zero-pages.pdf`        | valid PDF with no pages                        |
| `pdf/edge/encrypted-user-pw.pdf` | AES-256, user password `user123`               |
| `pdf/edge/encrypted-owner-only.pdf` | AES-256, owner password only                |
| `pdf/edge/not-a-pdf.pdf`         | plain text with a `.pdf` name                  |
| `pdf/edge/garbage-after-header.pdf` | `%PDF-` header, then random bytes           |
| `pdf/large/1200-pages.pdf`       | 1,200 blank pages                              |
| `pdf/text/arabic-2p.pdf`         | Arabic text (needs `--arabic-font`; pending)   |

Regenerate (encrypted files change on every run because of random salts):

```bash
services/pdfcore/.venv/Scripts/python.exe testdata/scripts/generate_corpus.py --arabic-font <font.ttf>
```
